cases.description: Cyclic pointer or self-referential graph terminates with explicit cycle status without stack overflow
High-degree or deeply nested structure exceeding traversal bounds terminates with explicit truncation
Cancelled context terminates redaction with explicit cancellation status
Deadline-exceeded context terminates redaction with explicit timeout status
Reordered equivalent inputs produce deterministic canonical output
Changed semantic fact produces a distinct explainable effect
Plaintext secret bytes are owned by provider and never enter metadata storage, logs, trace, disk or browser storage
